title: Classified signals lab picks up a signal from the implant
place_text: Southwest Research Institute, San Antonio, Texas

tellings.quote: And it turns off. And the lab guys say, "We've got a signal, but we can't tell you anything about it because the lab's classified."

plain: A small object said to have been removed from the writer Whitley Strieber's body, which he calls an implant, gave off a signal when tested at the Southwest Research Institute in San Antonio, Texas, in the mid 1990s. Strieber, who says he was involved, tells Michels the signal switched on and then turned off. He says the lab staff told him, "We've got a signal, but we can't tell you anything about it because the lab's classified," and he names a man called William Malow in the account.
